It is a program implemented in national schools and national-type schools for Murid Berkeperluan Pendidikan Khas (MBPK), or students with special education needs. Students in PPKI follow the existing curriculum, namely the Standard Curriculum for Primary Schools (KSSR) and the Standard Curriculum for Primary Schools Special Education (KSSRPK). PPKI classes are conducted mainly in Bahasa Melayu, and the Ministry of Education expands these classes yearly across national and national-type schools.
